decision: Prefer recognisable subjects over specialist recall in Sleeper, Time Drop and Clue Ladder. Add contemporary subjects to Sleeper and Clue Ladder; preserve Time Drop's ancient-to-modern range.
compatibility: Retain every original ID, category/topic and calendar slot; Time Drop replacements retain their era bucket. Complete captured snapshots remain authoritative. Stable IDs are retained authoring slots; historical slugs need not describe a revised subject.
limits: Editorial familiarity judgements need human playtesting. References are provided per record; selected primary checks are recorded below, not independent certification of every fact.
